item.description: ### Fixed - **Claude Code: a reply can no longer approve a permission prompt Perch had stopped showing.** When Claude ran tools in parallel, or a background subagent asked for permission, Perch could read the session as running or idle while the approval dialog was still open — and a reply sent from the phone or a notification then pressed Enter on the dialog's **Yes**. The session now reads "needs you" until that exact dialog is answered, and replies and Stop stay off until then. A background subagent's question for permission now shows as "needs you" for as long as it is open. - **Codex: a project that turns hooks off is recognised.** If a project's own `.codex/config.toml` sets `[features] hooks = false`, Perch can't see Codex's approval prompts there, so the row now says "hooks off in .codex/config.toml" and offers no replies or Stop.
